# Psalm 134 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 134:1 (overlap: 5%)

- **EMET:** A-song of-the-ascents. Behold bless YHWH all servants-of YHWH, the-standing in-house-of YHWH in-the-nights.
- **LOGOS:** A Song of Ascents. Come, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD, who stand by night in the house of the LORD!
- **PNEUMA:** A song for the journey to Jerusalem. Come, praise the LORD — all you servants of the LORD who serve in the LORD's house at night.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 134:3 (overlap: 8%)

- **EMET:** May-bless-you YHWH from-Zion, maker-of heaven and-earth.
- **LOGOS:** May the LORD bless you from Zion, he who made heaven and earth!
- **PNEUMA:** May the LORD — the maker of heaven and earth — bless you from Zion!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 134:2 (overlap: 9%)

- **EMET:** Lift your-hands to-the-sanctuary, and-bless YHWH.
- **LOGOS:** Lift up your hands to the holy place and bless the LORD!
- **PNEUMA:** Lift up your hands toward the sanctuary and praise the LORD!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
